newsitem.title: GREECE: Tasoglou in deal with Merloni.
newsitem.headline: Tasoglou in deal with Merloni.

text.p: Greece's electrical appliance wholesaler Tasoglou-Delonghi announced on Thursday it had reached an agreement with Italian household appliance maker Merloni Elettrodomestici.
Company president Spyros Tasoglou told shareholders at the annual general meeting that the company would expand its operations into the Cypriot market in September 1997.
He said turnover in the first five months of the year dropped to 2.1 billion drachmas from 2.4 billion in the comparable 1996 period due to stagnant demand and a rise in provisions for receivables.
Tasoglou-Delonghi saw its pretax profit drop 18.4 percent to 946 million drachmas in 1996 on turnover growth of 1.4 percent to 7.33 billion.
The company will pay a dividend per share of 84.5 drachmas for fiscal 1996. The shares will trade ex-dividend July 10.
Tasoglou-Delonghi lost nine drachmas to 740 on Thursday on volume of 5,980 shares. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
